title: Frozen-state Darcian steady-equivalent two-point interface-flux discriminator
scientific_question: On exact R2048-T16 C5R states projected to the retained D12_B2P5 storage state, does a zero-fit Darcian steady-equivalent nonlinear two-point flux reduce internal-interface flux error relative to CURRENT_LAYER_FACE without creating direction/HOLD defects?

workload.lower_boundary: unchanged C5R current Reference G0K0 prescribed-head semantics

retained_representation.state_definition: Integrated water storage in each retained layer, projected exactly from the fine Reference compartments at every observation boundary.
retained_representation.representative_suction_head: B14 inverse retention psi(theta), positive suction convention

exact_reference_face_reconstruction.formula: q_ref = 0.5*(K(h_up)+K(h_down)) * (1 + (h_up-h_down)/0.078125), with h in SWAP negative pressure-head convention.
exact_reference_face_reconstruction.constitutive: exact B14 Mualem-van Genuchten relation already frozen in C5R
exact_reference_face_reconstruction.face_index_rule: For a boundary depth b aligned to R2048, upper fine node index n=b/0.078125 and lower node n+1; the Reference internal flux is headcalc kmean(n+1)*head_gradient(n+1).
exact_reference_face_reconstruction.state_identity_requirement: All pre-existing LAREGW1_STATE and LAREGW1_PROFILE lines must be byte-identical to the authoritative C5R R2048_T16 route after removing new C5T diagnostic lines.

CURRENT_LAYER_FACE.formula: For adjacent retained layers i,j, q = Kij*(1 + (psi_j-psi_i)/L), L=(di+dj)/2, Kij=(dj*K_i + di*K_j)/(di+dj), using the frozen BC1 implementation.

DSE2P.name: Darcian steady-equivalent nonlinear two-point flux
DSE2P.endpoint_state: same representative psi_i, psi_j derived from exact projected layer storages
DSE2P.local_problem: Find constant downward q such that dpsi/dz = q/K(psi)-1 connects psi(0)=psi_i to psi(L)=psi_j over L=(di+dj)/2.
DSE2P.saturation_extension: For numerical shooting trials only, K(psi<=0)=Ksat; authoritative endpoints are required to remain in the admitted unsaturated B14 constitutive range.

numerical_method.formulation: For psi_down != psi_up and the monotone steady solution, solve L = integral_{psi_up}^{psi_down} K(psi)/(q-K(psi)) dpsi. For psi_down>psi_up use q>max K on the interval; for psi_down<psi_up use q<min K. Equal endpoints use q=K(psi).
numerical_method.primary_quadrature: 64-point Gauss-Legendre on the endpoint suction interval
numerical_method.root: deterministic bisection in the physically monotone q branch; expand only the remote bracket endpoint geometrically if a sign bracket is not yet obtained
numerical_method.quadrature_flux_agreement_gate: The independently solved 64- and 128-point roots must differ by <= max(1e-8 cm/day, 1e-7*max(1,abs(q128))).

hold_guard: maximum absolute candidate-minus-Reference HOLD flux error
metrics.all_interface_secondary: same diagnostics reported descriptively over all 11 internal faces

DSE2P_SUPPORTED_FOR_FREE_RUNNING_TEST: On the pooled primary moving-phase vector, DSE2P is componentwise no worse than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE for RMSE, mean-absolute interface/history signed bias, and sign-mismatch count.
DSE2P primary moving-phase RMSE is strictly smaller than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE by more than 1e-10 cm/day.
At each of 150, 155 and 157.5 cm, DSE2P moving-phase RMSE is no worse than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE within 1e-10 cm/day.
DSE2P does not increase primary HOLD sign mismatches and does not increase primary HOLD RMSE by more than 1e-10 cm/day.
All DSE2P numerical qualification gates pass.
adjudication.DSE2P_MIXED_NO_IMPLEMENTATION: Some preregistered interfaces/phases improve while others worsen, or HOLD/sign guards fail.
adjudication.DSE2P_NOT_SUPPORTED: CURRENT_LAYER_FACE is componentwise no worse on the primary moving vector, or DSE2P cannot be numerically/physically qualified.
adjudication.next_if_supported: Only then authorize a separate fresh blind free-running C5U test; no production use.
adjudication.next_if_mixed_or_not_supported: Do not fit/tune DSE2P. Return to storage-consistent algebraic subgrid-profile theory or representation-family comparison.

instrumentation_contract.permitted_change: Logging-only additions to the C5R R2048_T16 harness/materialized source.
emitted_per_observation: for each of 11 aligned internal faces: fine upper/lower pressure head and water content sufficient to reconstruct frozen Reference arithmetic-K face flux

implementation_binding.permitted_new_code: logging-only C5T outputs plus offline CURRENT_LAYER_FACE/DSE2P operator analysis
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: candidate feedback into Reference, free-running DSE2P, scalar tuning, state augmentation, response-based numerical retuning
